TEMPORAL_ASPECT.name: Temporal Anchoring & Aspectual Geometry
TEMPORAL_ASPECT.description: How events, states, and completed actions relate to speech time and reference points (Reichenbach logic).

categories.pedagogical_hook: The Rope of Experience — past action tethered directly to who you are in the present.
Flashback Marker — setting a hard milestone in the past before another past event occurred.
Finished Chapter — an event locked into a completed container of past time.
Inside the Movie — viewing the action as unfolding from within rather than as a closed box.

EPISTEMIC_STANCE.name: Epistemic Stance & Psychological Distance
EPISTEMIC_STANCE.description: How speakers signal certainty, doubt, hypothetical reality, and social hedging.

categories.pedagogical_hook: Parallel Universe — shifting tense backward to signal distance from current reality.
Alternate Past — exploring consequences that never actually took place.
Social Dimmer Switch — adjusting certainty from absolute commitment (must) to gentle possibility (might).

DEONTIC_FORCE.name: Deontic Force & Agency
DEONTIC_FORCE.description: How speakers negotiate obligation, permission, social hierarchy, and action control.

categories.pedagogical_hook: Rule vs. Authority — distinguishing internal desire (want to) from external compulsion (have to / must).
Direct Steering — seizing immediate control of the action without modal softening.
The Neutral Lens — placing focus on the product, outcome, or status rather than who did it.

ENTITY_TOPOLOGY.name: Entity Topology & Discourse Cohesion
ENTITY_TOPOLOGY.description: How entities are introduced, tracked, replaced, and arranged in spatial/mental space.

categories.pedagogical_hook: Spotlight Introduction — placing a new character or object onto the empty conversational stage.
Ghost Anchor — pointing back to a known entity without exhausting the listener with repetition.
The Laser Pointer — isolating one specific element ('What we really need is...') for contrast.
